objective: Implement the production Qiniu private-object provider boundary, first step of FD-004; offline acceptance is not real service acceptance or completion of FD-004.

acceptance.behavior: Implement file_delivery.qiniu_store.QiniuStore.from_file(path, *, session=None). JSON keys: access_key,secret_key,bucket,region,download_domain, optional timeout_seconds(default30,integer1..120). Required nonempty strings; bucket DNS-safe; region supported official Qiniu region IDs (at least z0,z1,z2,na0,as0,cn-east-2); download_domain HTTPS origin only, no credentials/query/fragment/path except trailing slash, no localhost/IP literal. Config is owner-only regular file(mode0600 or stricter), no symlink components; reject malformed/unsafe config with CONFIG_INVALID before network. Constructor performs no network. Do not expose credentials in repr, exception or logs. Optional qiniu extra pins qiniu==7.18.0; base dependencies remain empty and imports lazy.

ensure_private() queries real Qiniu bucketInfo API and requires integer private=1; missing, boolean, public or malformed privacy =>BUCKET_NOT_PRIVATE. upload always calls ensure_private before sending bytes. No changing bucket permissions/creating buckets. Use SDK Auth signing and real HTTPS endpoints derived from region (uc.qiniuapi.com, up-REGION.qiniup.com, rs-REGION.qiniuapi.com); never send credentials to configurable arbitrary management endpoints.

upload(path,key,retention_days=30) uploads exactly one local regular non-symlink file via form upload using insertOnly=1, scope bucket:key, deleteAfterDays positive integer1..3650, standard storage, no callbacks. Validate object key as relative POSIX segments without dot/dotdot/empty/backslash/control chars, at most1024 UTF8 bytes. Validate arguments before network. Success checks exact returned key and Qiniu etag(local file), returns status=uploaded,key,etag,size. Never upload a password or manifest implicitly, never overwrite remote object. HTTP614 =>REMOTE_CONFLICT. Form upload is sufficient here; resumable large-file support remains future performance work. Invalid key =>INVALID_OBJECT_KEY, invalid retention=>CONFIG_INVALID, returned key/etag mismatch=>REMOTE_INTEGRITY.

stat(key) performs authenticated stat and returns key,etag,size for valid hash/fsize; HTTP612 alone yields None. HTTP401/403=>REMOTE_AUTH; other definite HTTP4xx=>REMOTE_ERROR; malformed response=>REMOTE_ERROR. No assumption that arbitrary errors mean absent. All returned messages sanitized; no response bodies, tokens or URLs in errors.

signed_url(key,ttl_seconds=604800) returns url and integer expires_at; ttl integer1..604800, no booleans. Sign correctly URL-encoded HTTPS object path with e deadline and token using Qiniu Auth, no network. verify_download(key,expected_sha256,expected_size) first verifies anonymous request receives401/403 (2xx=>BUCKET_NOT_PRIVATE;404/redirect/other=>REMOTE_ERROR), then streams signed GET and computes exact SHA256 and size; mismatch=>REMOTE_INTEGRITY. Return status=link-verified,sha256,size without URL/token. Stop reading when declared size exceeded. Never write downloaded plaintext/archive to disk. Never claim expiry merely from generation. Invalid ttl=>CONFIG_INVALID; validate expected SHA256 as64 lowercase hex and expected_size as nonnegative integer, invalid=>CONFIG_INVALID before any request.

delete(key) makes one authenticated delete request, accepts200 or612, then stat must confirm absent; otherwise REMOTE_DELETE_UNCONFIRMED. Returns status=object-deleted,key only after confirmation. Remote deletion does not guarantee CDN cache purge or withdrawal of downloaded copies; no such claim. Does not delete any local bundle/password. Retention policy is scheduling, not immediate deletion or exact wall-clock deletion guarantee.

Use requests.Session.request(method,url,**kwargs) as injectable transport boundary. Production session disables implicit HTTP retries and trust_env; every request HTTPS, explicit finite timeout, allow_redirects=False; download stream=True. Close all response bodies including failures. At most one attempt per operation/request; no automatic retries. Timeout/connection failure or HTTP5xx=>REMOTE_UNKNOWN (outcome may already have happened), no exceptions containing provider body, secret or signedURL. API dependency absence=>DEPENDENCY_MISSING; local file IO=>IO_ERROR. API uses existing DeliveryError. Safe exceptions for unexpected malformed data. Meaningful Worker unit tests; prior frozen checks pass. New provider feature must not alter planner/archive/ledger behavior.
